name: I Expected of You
source:
The story is set in a modern fantasy world, among Kinetic Scholars, Elemental Experts, Troubadours and Diviners. It follows Daichi Hirawa, a high school student, during a special occasion in which every student gets assigned randomly to a group project assignment for a festival of historical significance, which happens in just 2 months. He will face not only expectations of this assignments but also recently added expectations of his father.

But most importantly during that time he must cooperate with 4 other people. Mayu Suisha, a confident rich girl, Yume Taue, a timid social butterfly, Youko Hinode, a mysterious bookworm, Ishir Khalsa, his loud best friend and possibly, even fall in love with one of the 3 girls.
translation:
故事发生在一个现代奇幻世界，其中有动能学者、元素专家、行吟诗人和占卜师。该剧讲述了一名高中生平和大知在一个特殊的场合，每个学生都被随机分配到一项小组项目作业，以参加一个具有历史意义的节日，这个节日只有两个月的时间。他不仅要面对这项任务的期望，还要面对最近增加的父亲的期望。

但最重要的是，这段时间他必须与另外4个人合作。Mayu Suisha，一个自信的富家女，Yume Taue，一个胆小的交际花，Youko Hinode，一个神秘的书呆子，Ishir Khalsa，他大声的最好的朋友，甚至可能爱上了三个女孩之一。
